title: 推拉加练 · 胸优先
goal: 给胸增加每周训练量，同时补足拉的量来平衡肩膀和姿态。腿只做热身，因为周一刚练、周五还有教练课。
goal_en: Add weekly chest volume and balance it with pulling work for shoulder health and posture. Legs stay light: you squatted on Monday and have the trainer again on Friday.
rationale: 教练课每次胸只有 3 组（俯卧撑或哑铃卧推），一周约 6 组。胸要长，一周 10 到 16 组更合适。今天补 10 组：卧推 4 组、绳索交叉 3 组、绳索夹胸 3 组。
推和拉要平衡。教练课教过的拉只有 TRX 划船，今天就用它，和夹胸做超级组。
周一刚做了深蹲和硬拉，周五还会做，所以今天腿只在热身里出现，核心用 Pallof 推和平板支撑。
中午练，距早饭 2 到 4 小时，强度中等：组间休息 90 秒，大部分组留 2 次余力，不做到力竭。
全部动作都是前三节课学过的，没有新动作。重量以课上记录为起点，不确定的先轻一档试一组。
rationale_en: Trainer sessions give the chest only 3 sets each (push-ups or dumbbell bench), about 6 sets a week. Chest grows better at 10 to 16 weekly sets. Today adds 10: 4 sets of bench, 3 of cable crossover, 3 of cable fly.
Push and pull need balance. The only pull you have learned is the TRX row, so today uses it, supersetted with the fly.
You squatted and deadlifted on Monday and will again on Friday, so legs appear only in the warm-up. Core work comes from the Pallof press and plank.
Training at noon, 2 to 4 hours after breakfast, means moderate intensity: 90 seconds rest, leave 2 reps in reserve on most sets, no sets to failure.
Every exercise was learned in the first three sessions; nothing new. Start from the weights logged in class, and when unsure, try one set one step lighter.

items.how: 慢一点，感觉肩胛骨往中间夹。
items.how_en: Go slow and feel the shoulder blades squeeze together.

items.how: 慢速，3 秒下 1 秒上，当作卧推的热身。
items.how_en: Slow tempo, 3 seconds down and 1 up, as a warm-up for the bench.

items.how: 第 2 节课没记重量，先用 20 lb 做一组 10 个试手。第 4 组做完还能多做 2 次就是对的重量；能做满 10 个就下次加 5 lb。
items.how_en: Session 2 had no weight logged, so try one set of 10 at 20 lb first. The right weight leaves 2 reps in the tank after set 4. If you get all 10, add 5 lb next time.

items.target: 第 1 节记的 2.5 档，先试这一档
items.target_en: the 2.5 setting logged in Session 1; try that first
items.how: 第 1 节课做过。滑轮调到最高，双手从上往下画弧到小腹前，手可以交叉。12 次做完还有 2 次余力就对了，记清档位。
items.how_en: Done in Session 1. Pulleys at the top, sweep both hands down and in to the lower belly, hands may cross. 12 reps with 2 in reserve is right; note the exact pin.

blocks.name: 第二组 · 拉 + 夹胸（超级组）
blocks.rest: 两个动作连做，然后休息 60 到 90 秒
blocks.rest_en: do both back to back, then rest 60 to 90 seconds

items.target: 自重，身体放得越平越重
items.target_en: bodyweight; the flatter you lean, the harder
items.how: 课上做过三次。脚往前挪一点让身体更平，10 次刚好吃力就对了。拉到胸口，肩胛骨夹紧停 1 秒。
items.how_en: Done in all three sessions. Walk the feet forward so the body is flatter; the right angle makes 10 reps hard. Pull to the chest, squeeze the shoulder blades, hold 1 second.

items.target: 每侧 12 次能完成的档位
items.target_en: a pin setting you can do 12 times per side
items.how: 第 1 节课记的 12.5 单位不明，今天记清楚是哪个档位。手臂微弯固定，像抱一棵树。
items.how_en: Session 1 logged 12.5 with no unit, so note the exact pin today. Keep a slight fixed bend in the elbows, like hugging a tree.

blocks.name: 第三组 · 肩 + 核心

items.how: 课上用 12.5 lb，如果 10 个很轻松就换 15 lb。
items.how_en: You used 12.5 lb in class. If 10 reps feel easy, move to 15 lb.

items.target: 能站稳不转身的最轻档位
items.target_en: the lightest pin at which you can stay square without twisting
items.how: 推出去停 2 秒，身体不转。
items.how_en: Press out, hold 2 seconds, keep the torso square.

items.how: 两组都做到做不动为止，记下次数。这是俯卧撑 20 个里程碑的测试。
items.how_en: Both sets to failure, write down the reps. This is the test for the 20 push-up milestone.

cooldown.text: 约 5 分钟。今天练了胸和推，重点放松胸、肩前侧和肱三头，再用婴儿式放松划船用到的背。每个动作做到有拉伸感、不疼，保持时呼吸放慢。
cooldown.text_en: About 5 minutes. Today was chest and pressing, so the focus is the chest, front of the shoulders and triceps, with a child's pose to release the back after the rows. Stretch to a pull, never pain, and slow the breathing while holding.
cooldown.rest: 不休息，动作之间直接换
cooldown.rest_en: no rest, move straight from one to the next

items.how: 教练教过的侧躺开书。膝盖压住地面不抬起，手打开到最远处停 2 秒再合上。打开胸和胸椎。
items.how_en: The side-lying open book your trainer taught. Keep the top knee pinned to the floor; open the arm as far as it goes, hold 2 seconds, close. Opens the chest and mid-back.

items.how: 用深蹲架立柱或门框。肘和肩同高，前臂贴柱，同侧脚向前迈，身体慢慢前倾到胸前侧有拉感。肩不要耸起。
items.how_en: Use the squat rack upright or a door frame. Elbow at shoulder height, forearm on the post, step forward with the same-side foot and lean until you feel the front of the chest. Keep the shoulder down.

items.how: 教练教过的掰肘拉伸。手肘指向天花板，另一只手把肘往头后轻拉，上身别歪。
items.how_en: The elbow-pull stretch your trainer taught. Point the elbow at the ceiling and gently pull it behind the head with the other hand; keep the torso upright.

items.how: 教练教过的婴儿式。手尽量往前爬，臀部往脚跟坐，深呼吸 5 次。放松背阔肌和下背。
items.how_en: The child's pose your trainer taught. Walk the hands forward, sit the hips back to the heels, take 5 deep breaths. Releases the lats and lower back.

items: 把每个动作的实际重量和次数告诉 Claude，这一页会变成“自练 1”的记录。
哪个动作的重量和课上记的差很多？告诉我，下次计划据此调整。
练完 30 分钟内吃午饭，先吃碳水和蛋白质。
周五教练课前不要再练胸。
items_en: Tell Claude the actual weight and reps for each exercise; this page becomes the log for Self Session 1.
Did any weight differ a lot from what was logged in class? Tell me and the next plan adjusts.
Eat lunch within 30 minutes of finishing, carbs and protein first.
No more chest work before Friday's trainer session.
